text:
Sam B: Heads-up — planning a two-phase rollout tonight 23:00 UTC for the runtime scheduling change (internal name: thermostat). This touches API routing headers, runtime kernel flags, and Console metrics. Need pins from Console + Router and SLA guardrail confirmations.
Olivia M: Can you call out what Console needs to pin? Also will update release notes once we confirm pinned variants. :eyes:
Krish P: Runtime plan: Phase A = 5% traffic for 15m, Phase B = 30% for 30m, auto-ramp only if p50/p95 within baseline and error-rate < 0.1%. Rollback if p99 latency +10% over baseline OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m.
DeployBot: [deploy-schedule] wave_id=6723, requested_by=Sam B, start=4444444444, preflight_checks=OK.
Maya R: Router note — we'll need to pin router rule to use header split x-thermostat-version=v2 for canary. Also need to ensure sticky session TTL stays unchanged.
Lee T: SRE: define exact metric thresholds we want on dashboards. I'll watch p50/p99, error-rate, and 99th token latency from runtime. Suggest p99 threshold = baseline * 1.12 as a soft alarm, 1.20 hard rollback.
Sam B: Ack. Proposed guardrails: soft alert at +12% p99, auto-hold; hard rollback at +20% or error-rate >0.5% for 5m. Will document in release notes.
Krish P: Canary config (deploybot-compatible):
```json
{
  "wave_id": 6723,
  "phases": [
    {"pct": 5, "duration_min": 15},
    {"pct": 30, "duration_min": 30}
  ],
  "rollback_triggers": {
    "p99_multiplier": 1.20,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5
  },
  "fallback_variant": "runtime-v3.2.4"
}
```
Olivia M: I'll pin Console to UI-build 2026.03.10 which is compatible with the new runtime telemetry. Updating release note draft: <https://internal.redwood/release-notes|release-notes>.
DeployBot: Canary scheduled. Preflight passed. Initiating first wave at T+30m unless blocked.
Lee T: I'll open a short-lived alert channel and runbook snippet. If we cross soft guardrails, hold traffic and call for triage. If hard triggers, we rollback via deploybot revert to runtime-v3.2.4 and router pin back to previous rule.
Maya R: Router team acked. We'll stage the header-split rule change and keep a quick revert script. :thumbsup:
Sam B: Good. Ops on-call: @Lee T and @Krish P will be primary. Olivia will coordinate release notes and console pin. I'll kick off the canary at T-30 and monitor. If anyone sees anything odd before start, flag here.
Krish P: One more: metric to watch — KV cache hit ratio. If it drops >8% we'll treat as early-warning.
Lee T: noted. I'll add KV hit ratio to the alert dashboard.
Olivia M: Copy. Publishing final release note entry and pinning Console.
Sam B: Thanks everyone — rolling forward unless we hit rollback triggers. :rocket:
